title: Cover times and ranges of elephant random walks
summary: We study cover times on discrete tori and ranges on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ for elephant random walks with memory parameter $p\in[0,1)$. In dimension one there is a phase transition at $p=3/4$. Away from criticality we determine the exact first-order asymptotics of the mean cover time, while at $p=3/4$ the mean is of order $L^2/\sqrt{\log L}$, a factor $\sqrt{\log L}$ larger than the natural fluctuation scale $L^2/\log L$.
